## Standing note

Remember: Client A's client statements go through the figure-trace gate before any number is quoted.

## Deploy rule

Use scripts/deploy-clawdy.sh, never copy bytes ad hoc.

## Screener rule

A single-stock buy needs a same-day screener CANDIDATE runId.

## Rotating the MySQL password

Rotate in 1Password first, then restart the acme MCP server, then verify with the smoke query.

## Week 27 summary

Decided on sqlite-vec over faiss for vector search. Client A asked for shorter replies on the phone. The Zwift workout push was postponed.

## Session log

Jas asked whether to add miles to today's run; TSB was -2.9 so the answer was one or two easy miles.

## Shopping

Compared the Garmin Forerunner 265 and 965; the 965 has maps.

## BSX incident

The agent quoted BSXX figures for BSX. Correction posted; suitability gate now requires the ticker to match the DATA block.

## Old session

Renamed the projects channel and moved the tmux session to the Mac mini.

## Flush

Mid-session: the fin-client workspace revamp was planned in six phases, P0 security first.

## Trip

Jas is flying to Lisbon on October 12 and wants a three-day itinerary for Principe Real.

## Lunch

Tacos on Tuesday; the taqueria on 5th closes at three.

## Account swap

The /clawcode-account swap restarted the fleet; fin-client held the boot for six minutes.
